idea.title: Boundary-conditioned spectral refinement for multispectral OBB detection
idea.claim: Current predicted boundaries can route local spectral evidence to improve iterative OBB localization beyond object-shared spectral routing.
idea.recipe_note: All paired experiments share fressdet_paper_protocol.yml: full MODA train/test, 20 epochs, W1216 x H928, global batch8, scratch initialization, no augmentation, and ProbIoU AP50 checkpoint selection. O2 model semantics remain inherited. Superseded recipes were removed with resolved configuration equivalence verified.
idea.design_review_note: Current v1 remains an implicit geometry-feature residual prototype. Point-preserving, reliability-calibrated explicit geometric refinement is a reviewed v2 proposal, not an implemented detector.
